sections.Profile:
"Jokerz!" is a pinball machine released by Williams in December 1988, designed by Barry Oursler and Python Anghelo with artwork by John Youssi. It features a card and casino theme, integrating two flippers, three ramps, and a two-ball multiball mode. The machine is part of the Williams System 11B series and includes music and sound by Chris Granner and Jon Hey.
